title: Official Packaging & Product Specification: Amul Gold Full Cream Milk
manufacturer: Gujarat Co-operative Milk Marketing Federation Ltd. (GCMMF)
description: Standardized and pasteurized full cream milk meeting Food Safety and Standards (FSSAI) requirements.

packaging.material: Multi-layer Low Density Polyethylene (LDPE/LLDPE) Food-grade Film
packaging.storage_condition: Store continuously under refrigeration at 8°C or below
packaging.shelf_life: 48 hours from date of packing under refrigeration

packaging_versions.visual_cues: Classic red wave graphics, Amul Girl in chef hat holding milk glass, standard nutritional table without explicit added sugar subline.
Updated FSSAI 2020 nutrition table declaration (explicit Added Sugar: 0.0g), QR traceability code on back panel, modernized typography.
